superseded.reason: Not released: three checks failed and the Tier 2 gate was interrupted. own_key_real and no_key_paths (and the CLI cases of the staging check) failed with 401 'a session is required': the CLI kept reusing a saved guest session after the service no longer had it (sessions last 24 h; the staging stack is recreated with a new volume each time) and never started a new one. Fixed in src/cli.py (a saved session the service rejects is replaced by a new guest session, with a message; other 401s still fail) with a test. live_site_external could not test this candidate: a README edit (553cc68) was pushed to main after the candidate was cut, so the dispatched public-demo workflow ran on 553cc68, and the check then crashed on an empty gh response (JSONDecodeError). scripts/release-check.py now refuses to dispatch when origin/main is not the candidate and retries empty gh output. The Tier 2 attempt for this candidate (release-f90ffea281af in evidence/release-gate-ledger.json) was started at 09:55 UTC and interrupted when the session running it ended, after 35 of 48 pairs and before any result; its outcome stays empty and it was not read. ci_tier1, linked_reports, readme_fresh, offline_reproduction, fresh_clone_verify and demo_rebuilt passed on this candidate.
